base_rate_triangulation.consensus_note: Non-ransomware LEF anchored in Coalition 2025 (70.3% of claims are non-RW) x IRIS baseline. Mode 2.5% = ~0.7 x IRIS mid-market mode 3.5%.

vector_proportions._citation: DBIR 2026 vector shares, adjusted for exfiltration pattern (DBIR 2025 Espionage)

exfiltration_overall_share._citation: DBIR 2026 espionage pattern ~8% of breaches; IRIS does not separate exfiltration. Judgment anchor.

exfiltration_sector_shares._citation: Derived from sector_multipliers x overall_share. Not directly measured — tracks all-incident ratios from IRIS 2025 Figure A1.

exfiltration_revenue_shares._citation: No exfiltration-specific revenue breakdown available. Uses all-incident shares from IRIS 2025.

exfiltration_revenue_prob_gte2._citation: Not available from IRIS for exfiltration specifically. All null — tool falls back to overall floor.

sector_multipliers._citation: IRIS 2025 Figure A1 sector multipliers (exfiltration pattern tracks all-incident)

credential_tempo._citation: Exfiltration credential vector uses same tempo data as ransomware (Recorded Future + IR reports). Both attack types target the same credential markets.

exploitation_scanning._citation: GreyNoise-derived scanning telemetry. Exfiltration uses same scanning infrastructure as ransomware for initial access.
exploitation_scanning.poa_ransomware_note: Lower than ransomware — exfiltration actors are more selective.
exploitation_scanning.ransomware_proportion_note: Exfiltration-motivated scanning is a smaller share than ransomware-motivated.

output_templates.one_sentence: Based on industry data, threat actors {attempt_verb} organizations matching your profile roughly once every {recurrence_years:.0f} years (range: {low_yr:.0f}-{high_yr:.0f} years). This measures how often adversaries TRY -- not how often they succeed. Success probability depends on your controls (assessed separately).
